celebPage.similarFormula: The candidate pool includes every active public figure with values for all 16 axes. Similar Figures compares the full spectrum; disposition, virtue, and ability matches compare only the named axes and convert distance to a 0–100% match. Opposing Disposition excludes abilities and virtues, reverses only the subject’s four disposition axes, and converts that distance to a 0–100% clash score.
